_about: Фото первого экрана квизов (правки 13.11): реалистичная машина на причале порта, по образцу баннера клиента в Marquiz, но без надписей и логотипов поверх. Шаг 1: квадрат 1024×1024 в Figma (generate_image, gpt-image-2.5-sunburst) по template или prompt. Шаг 2: Figma Weave, Nano Banana Pro 2K, aspect 4:5 дорисовывает небо сверху и причал снизу (на ПК фото на всю правую половину экрана, на телефоне показывается квадрат из середины); у кадра с тремя Stepwgn тем же шагом задний черный заменен на кузов 2015 года по фото заказчика (fix). Сырые PNG кладутся как <file>_raw.png, обработка: python3 квизы/renders.py <папка>, затем node квизы/build.mjs. Картинка подключается к квизу по полю model; alt — запасной вариант, на страницу не ставится. Поле prompt заменяет шаблон целиком.
template: Photorealistic automotive advertising photograph, square format. A {subject}, painted {paint}, stands on a clean concrete pier of a commercial sea port at golden hour. Front three-quarter view of the car's front-left side, the car's front points toward the left edge of the frame, camera at headlight height, 35mm lens. Behind the car: a large container ship loaded with stacked orange, blue and red shipping containers, port cranes, calm sea, warm low sun near the horizon on the left, clear blue sky with a few soft clouds. The whole car is fully visible, centered horizontally with wide empty margins on both sides, occupying about 66% of the frame width, standing in the lower half of the frame, open sky in the upper third. Japanese-market version with accurate real-world body shape, headlights, grille, bumpers and proportions of this exact model and generation. Realistic paint reflections, sharp details, natural colors. No text, no captions, no logos or badges added on top of the image, no watermark, blank license plate, no people.

items.prompt: Photorealistic automotive advertising photograph, square format. Three Honda Stepwgn minivans of different years stand in a staggered diagonal row on a clean concrete pier of a commercial sea port at golden hour. All three are shown in front three-quarter view of their front-left side, all facing toward the left edge of the frame, camera at headlight height, 35mm lens. Closest to the camera, at the front left: the newest sixth generation Honda Stepwgn AIR (2022-present) in deep midnight blue pearl, a very boxy upright minivan with a flat vertical nose, slim horizontal LED headlights joined by a thin black horizontal grille band with the Honda logo, a simple flat lower bumper with a wide black horizontal air intake, black alloy wheels, large side windows and sliding rear doors. In the middle, slightly behind it and to the right: the fifth generation Honda Stepwgn Spada after the 2017 facelift in pearl white, with a large chrome grille made of three thick horizontal chrome bars, sharp swept-back LED headlights, a sculpted front bumper with chrome accents and a roof spoiler. Furthest back, on the right: the earlier fifth generation Honda Stepwgn Spada (2015-2017) in glossy black, with a rounder nose, a slim chrome grille bar above a dark mesh grille, projector headlights and a curved chrome strip on the lower bumper. All three cars are fully visible, none cut off by the frame edges, together occupying about 88% of the frame width, standing in the lower half of the frame. Behind the cars: a large container ship loaded with stacked orange, blue and red shipping containers, port cranes, calm sea, warm low sun near the horizon on the left, clear blue sky with a few soft clouds, open sky in the upper third. Japanese-market versions with accurate real-world body shapes, headlights, grilles, bumpers and proportions of these exact models. Realistic paint reflections, sharp details, natural colors. No text, no captions, no logos or badges added on top of the image, no watermark, blank license plates, no people.

extend_prompt: Extend this photo to a 4:5 vertical frame (outpainting). Keep the original picture unchanged in the middle: the same car with the same body, color, size and position, the same container ship, cranes, sea, sun and lighting. Add more sky with soft warm clouds at the top and more of the same concrete pier with long evening shadows at the bottom. Photorealistic and seamless, no text, no logos added, blank license plate, no people.
